6901: Start on hands and knees, with wrists under shoulders and knees under hips.
Inhale and let your belly drop toward the floor.
Lift your chest and tailbone while your gaze goes slightly forward.
Keep your shoulders away from your ears.
6902: Sit with one knee stacked over the other and your feet beside your hips.
Reach one arm up and bend the elbow, hand down your back.
Sweep the other arm behind you and try to clasp your fingers.
Keep your spine tall and your chest open.
6910: Grip two parallel bars and hold a straight plank position.
Keep your elbows at about 45 degrees.
Lower your chest below the level of your hands.
Press back up until your arms are straight.
Keep your body in one line throughout.
6913: Sit tall with arms relaxed at your sides or held in front.
Pull your shoulder blades together and slightly down.
6914: Sit tall with elbows bent and hands by your ribs.
Draw your elbows back and pinch your shoulder blades together.
6944: Stand with feet shoulder-width apart and knees slightly bent.
Swing one arm forward and over in a crawl stroke.
Alternate arms in a smooth, continuous rhythm.
Rotate your torso slightly with each stroke.
Keep going at a steady pace for 30-60 seconds.
6958: Stand beside a low hurdle with feet together.
Swing your arms and jump sideways over it.
Land softly on both feet with knees bent.
Jump straight back over the other way.
Keep your ground contact quick and controlled.
6959: Anchor a band across a rack or set of bars at chest height.
Rest your torso on the band in a plank position.
Lower your chest toward the floor, elbows at 45 degrees.
Press up using the bounce of the band as help.
Keep your body in a straight line.
6961: Hang from the bar with one hand higher or on a towel and the other lower.
Brace your core and pull your chest up.
Lead with the working arm and pull your chin toward the bar.
Switch the hand positions on the next set.
6964: Stand with your feet hip-width apart and the dumbbells at shoulder height.
Brace your abs and lift your chest tall.
Press the dumbbells overhead while gently extending your upper back.
Keep your ribs down and avoid arching your lower back.
Lower to your shoulders with control.
6982: Start in a plank with your hands under your shoulders.
Spread your fingers and keep your wrists stacked.
Lower your chest to the floor under control.
Keep your body straight from head to heels.
6986: Stand facing a wall and place your hands on it with hips back.
Lower your head toward the wall, bending the elbows.
Push explosively away from the wall.
Land softly back into the start position.
Keep your core braced and back flat.
